details: Correct terrain-relative draw order and physical convex top corners, both inward directions.

regression.legacyDecorationFlag: Superseded: old test assumed void-warning decorations; dedicated visualChecks is authoritative.

rootCauses: Generated source atlas empty pixels had alpha 1-7/255 instead of zero
One or two pixels of padding under painted soles
Transparent end rows in repeating Rope sprite
Old stone positions came from void warnings instead of supported corners
Same sorting layer/order let terrain cover hero
corrections: Artwork Lit shader clips alpha below .05 and keeps installed URP 2D lighting in all passes; original PNG bytes unchanged
Sprite metadata recropped, IDs and world pivots preserved
Exposed cell corners confirmed using actual CompositeCollider2D top/side rays and standing clearance
observed: Native Unity compilation and Play Mode
No faint rectangle seen around hero in Game
Mid-pull-up fixture inspected with artwork ahead of support and stone on both corners
Temporary fixture camera/scene removed by stopping Play; temporary probes archived with meta and verified hash
limitations: Exact hand/anatomy continuity remains art polish, not certified for every frame
Sloped or obstructed corners can deliberately lack decoration
No full-world or mobile performance regression repeated
